headline: No API change affects the bot today and research was thin, so there are two risk ideas: count the room left today in stops instead of dollars, and check whether your real losing trades lose more than the $1 you plan to risk.

ideas.title: "Stops left today" after every loss
ideas.why: After each loss the guard says how many planned stops fit before the daily limit (e.g. 5 USDT room ÷ 1 USDT risk = 5). Under 3, it says to halve the next trade's size; at 0 you're done. You see the end of the day coming in trades, not after it's gone.

ideas.title: Planned risk vs real loss in /week
ideas.why: Your rules say risk about 1 USDT a trade, but leverage changes margin, not the loss at the stop. /week compares each losing trade with that 1 USDT: "losers averaged 2.3× planned risk, 4 lost over 3×". It shows if stops are skipped or size is set from leverage.
